# Introduction

This experiments aims at understanding the impact of a chronic oral exposure to imidacloprid on olfactory learning and memory performance.

Bees were reared in cages for 7 days with access to sucrose solution (50% w/w) supplemented or not with Imidacloprid (1ng/g or (5ng/g). After 7 days, they were conditioned in 5 trials to learn the association between an odor (1-hexanol) and a sucrose reward (50% w/w). The odor and the sucrose were either presented in combination (paired conditioning) or alone (unpaired conditioning) (see Matsumoto et al. 2012). Memory tests were performed 1h or 72h after conditioning.

**Independent variables:**
Group/Treatment: CTL, IMI (1ng/g) or IMI (5ng/g).
Condition: P (for paired) or U (for unpaired).
TestTime: 1 or 72

**Dependent variables:**
- A.1, A.2, A.3, A.4, A.5 correspond to the presence (1) or absence (0) of proboscis extension in reponse to the odor across the 5 learning trials
-AcqScore: Sum of the responses to the five trials for each bee (from 0 to 4)
- CS, Nod, SpecMem: response to the conditioned odour (CS) or new odor (Nod) during the memory test. SpecMem is the difference between CS and Nod (specific memory)

!!! Caution !!! In data2, responses to the 5 trials are concatenated.


# Set up

Load packages
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggsignif)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(afex)
library(lsmeans)
library(car)
```

Load datasets and add important variables
```{r datasets,echo=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
data<-read.csv('ResultsBehaviour.csv',header=T,sep=';')
data<-na.omit(data) # Bees who died before the memory test are not kept in the analysis
for (i in c(1:nrow(data))){
  data$AcqScore[i]<-sum(c(data$A.1[i],data$A.2[i],data$A.3[i],data$A.4[i],data$A.5[i]))
}
data<-data[data$A.1==0,]

data2<-cbind(rep(1:nrow(data),5),rep(as.character(data$Group),5))
data2<-as.data.frame(data2)
colnames(data2)<-c('BeeID','Treatment')
data2$PER<-c(data$A.1, data$A.2, data$A.3, data$A.4, data$A.5)
data2$Condition<-rep(as.character(data$Condition), 5) 
data2$Essai<-c(rep('E1',nrow(data)),rep('E2',nrow(data)),rep('E3',nrow(data)),rep('E4',nrow(data)),rep('E5',nrow(data)))
data2$TestTime<-rep(as.character(data$TestTime), 5)
data2$AcqScore<-rep(as.numeric(data$AcqScore), 5)
data2$Cage<-rep(data$Cage,5)

lev.ord.mem <- c("U", "P")
```

# Statistical Analyses

## Learning performance

Learning performance was analysed with a glmer (family=binomial; random effect is 'BeeID') followed by a posthoc analysis per trial using the fdr correction method.

Model responses across conditioning trials. 
```{r, echo=FALSE}
m1<-glmer(PER~Essai*Condition*Treatment+(1|BeeID),data2, family=binomial(link='logit'), glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
Anova(m1)
```

Model simplification
```{r, echo=FALSE}
m2<-glmer(PER~Essai*Condition+Essai*Treatment+Condition*Treatment+(1|BeeID),data2, family=binomial(link='logit'), glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000)))
anova(m1, m2, test='LRT')
Anova(m2)
```

Pair-wise comparisons
```{r, echo=FALSE}
refgrid<-lsmeans(m2, ~Condition&Treatment|Essai) 
pairs(refgrid, adjust='fdr') # fdr correction
```

## MTM: Memory after 1H

Create dataset for learners
```{r, echo=FALSE}

learners<-data[data$Condition=='P' & data$A.5=='1',]
unpaired<-data[data$Condition=='U',]
learners<-rbind(learners, unpaired)
data3<-cbind(rep(1:nrow(learners),2),rep(as.character(learners$Group),2))
data3<-as.data.frame(data3)
colnames(data3)<-c('BeeID','Treatment')
data3$MemResp<-c(learners$CS,learners$Nod)
data3$Condition<-rep(as.character(learners$Condition), 2) 
data3$TestTime<-rep(learners$TestTime,2)
data3$MemOdor<-c(rep('CS',nrow(learners)),rep('Nod',nrow(learners)))
data3$SpecMem<-rep(learners$SpecMem,2)
data3$Cage<-rep(learners$Cage,2)
mem1H_learners<-data3[data3$TestTime==1,]
mem72H_learners<-data3[data3$TestTime==72,]
```

Model simplification
```{r, echo=FALSE}
m1b<-glm(MemResp~Condition*Treatment*MemOdor, mem1H_learners, family=binomial(link=logit))
Anova(m1b)

m2b<-glm(MemResp~Condition*Treatment+MemOdor*Treatment+MemOdor*Condition, mem1H_learners, family=binomial(link=logit))
Anova(m2b) # No interaction Condition:Treatment (Chi= 0.143, p=0.93)  
anova(m1b,m2b, test='LRT')

m3b<-glm(MemResp~MemOdor*Treatment+MemOdor*Condition, mem1H_learners, family=binomial(link=logit))
Anova(m3b)
anova(m2b,m3b, test='LRT')
```

Pair-wise comparisons
```{r, echo=FALSE}
refgrid<-lsmeans(m3b, ~Treatment*Condition|MemOdor) 
pairs(refgrid, adjust='fdr') # fdr correction
refgrid<-lsmeans(m3b, ~MemOdor*Condition|Treatment) 
pairs(refgrid, adjust='fdr') # fdr correction
```

## Late-LTM: Memory after 72H

Model simplification
```{r, echo=FALSE}
m1c<-glm(MemResp~Condition*Treatment*MemOdor, mem72H_learners, family=binomial(link=logit))
Anova(m1c)

m2c<-glm(MemResp~Condition*Treatment+MemOdor*Condition+MemOdor*Treatment, mem72H_learners, family=binomial(link=logit))
Anova(m2c) # No interaction Treatment:MemOdor (chi= 0.906, p = 0.636)   
anova(m1c,m2c, test='LRT')

m3c<-glm(MemResp~Condition*Treatment+MemOdor*Condition, mem72H_learners, family=binomial(link=logit))
Anova(m3c)
anova(m2c,m3c, test='LRT')
```

Pair-wise comparisons
```{r, echo=FALSE}
refgrid<-lsmeans(m3c, ~Treatment*Condition|MemOdor) 
pairs(refgrid, adjust='fdr') # fdr correction
refgrid<-lsmeans(m3c, ~MemOdor*Condition|Treatment) 
pairs(refgrid, adjust='fdr') # fdr correction
```


# Graphical representations

## MTM: Memory after 1H

```{r, echo=FALSE}
data_summary <- function(data, varname, groupnames){
  require(plyr)
  summary_func <- function(x, col){
    c(mean = mean(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE),
      sd = sd(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE))
  }
  data_sum<-ddply(data, groupnames, .fun=summary_func,
                  varname)
  data_sum <- rename(data_sum, c("mean" = varname))
 return(data_sum)
}

SpecMem<-mem1H_learners[mem1H_learners$MemOdor=='CS',]
data.sum<-data_summary(SpecMem, 'SpecMem', c('Condition','Treatment'))

p1<-ggplot(data.sum, aes(interaction(factor(Condition,lev.ord.mem), Treatment), SpecMem)) +  
  geom_bar(aes(fill=Treatment), stat='identity', width=0.6, col="black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("gold2", "darkorange2", "violet")) + 
  ylab('% Specicic Memory') +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank( ), legend.position = 'none', panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,1))
p1
```

